title: Pure Artifact
summary: Artifact cards with Rank 5 Xyz bosses, Links and staples. Every Main Deck Artifact is a Level 5 LIGHT Fairy that can be Set in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell, then Special Summons itself and triggers a disruption or value effect when destroyed there during the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Enablers & Triggers
points: Artifact Sanctum Special Summons any Artifact monster straight from the Deck on the opponent's turn, and destroys a card on the field if destroyed by the opponent.
Artifact Ignition destroys a Spell/Trap on the field (your own Set Artifact on the opponent's turn, or an opposing back row card) and Sets an Artifact monster directly from the Deck.

Artifact Beagalltach Special Summons itself when destroyed in the Spell & Trap Zone on the opponent's turn and destroys up to two of your other Set cards, chain-detonating Set Artifacts like Moralltach and Failnaught.

Artifact Dagda (Link-2) Sets an Artifact monster from your hand or Deck into your Spell & Trap Zone as a Quick Effect whenever another card's effect activates on the field, and destroys it during the opponent's next End Phase.

summary.title: Opponent's-Turn Line: Sanctum or Ignition + Beagalltach
steps: Set Artifact Moralltach or Artifact Failnaught in your Spell & Trap Zone, or Set one from the Deck via Artifact Dagda when any card on the field activates.
On the opponent's turn, activate Artifact Sanctum to Special Summon Artifact Beagalltach from the Deck (or destroy a Set Beagalltach with Artifact Ignition).
Beagalltach destroys up to two Set Artifacts in your Spell & Trap Zone, triggering them in the GY to Special Summon themselves and fire their arrival effects.
Activate Artifacts Unleashed (or wait for your turn) to Xyz Summon Artifact Durendal or Chronomaly Vimana using two Level 5 Artifacts.

summary.title: The Artifact Toolbox
points: Artifact Moralltach destroys 1 face-up card the opponent controls without targeting when Special Summoned on the opponent's turn.
Artifact Failnaught Sets an Artifact monster from your GY into your Spell & Trap Zone on arrival, reloading Moralltach or Beagalltach.

Artifact Caduceus draws 1 card each time another Artifact is Special Summoned during the opponent's turn, while Artifact Lancea tributes itself from the hand or field on the opponent's turn to prevent all banishing.
Artifact Vajra wipes your entire Spell & Trap Zone on arrival to detonate every Set Artifact at once, and Chakram, Labrys, Aegis and Achilleshield protect your back row and monsters.

summary.title: Rank 5 Extra Deck
points: Artifact Durendal (Rank 5) detaches a material as a Quick Effect to either rewrite an opposing monster effect or Normal Spell/Trap activation into 'Destroy 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls' (forcing them to pop your Set Artifact) or shuffle both players' hands into the Deck and redraw.
Chronomaly Vimana (Rank 5) attaches an Xyz from your GY to boost ATK and detaches 2 materials to negate an opposing monster effect.
Number 61: Volcasaurus, Tiras, Keeper of Genesis, Adreus, Keeper of Armageddon and Imperial Princess Quinquery provide Rank 5 removal and extension on your turn.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Artifact Scythe and Artifact Mjollnir are both Forbidden in the TCG.

main: Artifact Moralltach
Destroys a face-up card when it arrives on their turn.
Artifact Beagalltach
Destroys up to two of your Set cards when it arrives, setting off more Artifacts.
Artifact Failnaught
Sets an Artifact from the GY when it arrives.
Artifact Lancea
Tributes from the hand on their turn to stop all banishing.
Artifact Vajra
Destroys all your Spell/Trap Zone cards when it arrives; stops a direct attack.
Artifact Caduceus
Draws each time an Artifact arrives on their turn.
Artifact Labrys
Summons itself from the hand when an Artifact is destroyed.
Artifact Chakram
Summons itself from the hand when your Spells/Traps would be destroyed.
Artifact Aegis
Protects your Artifacts from their effects when it arrives.
Artifact Achilleshield
Stops attacks on your Artifacts when it arrives.
Artifact Ignition
Quick-Play: destroys a Spell/Trap and Sets an Artifact from the Deck.
Artifacts Unleashed
Xyz Summons with two Artifacts on either turn.
Artifact Sanctum
Summons an Artifact from the Deck; destroys a card if they destroy it.
